name: Hidden Quicksand Trap (CR 9)
body:
Hidden Quicksand Trap
CR 9

XP 6,400

Type magical; Perception DC 24; Disable Device DC 24

EFFECTS

Trigger proximity (alarm); Reset automatic

Effect spell effect (hallucinatory terrain, DC 15)

Quicksand is often deceptive, magically-enhanced quicksand especially so. This trap covers a quicksand pit with a permanent illusion of trees and jungle plants. Unless a character sees through the illusion, the Survival DC for spotting the quicksand increases to 18.
